title: Plural genitive of common diphthong words
focus: Drop the first vowel of ie, yö or uo before -iden or -itten in these one-syllable words: tie (“road”) → teiden.
targetSkills: Plural genitive of common diphthong words

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural genitive of tie (“road”).
exercises.explanation: Drop i from ie: tie → te-; add -iden or -itten. These standard forms are all accepted: teiden, teitten.
requiredSkills: Plural genitive of common diphthong words
exercises.targetSkill: Plural genitive of common diphthong words
